items.text: Small update to fix an old bug related to the in-game display for Achievements:
* Fixed issue with showing the "Complete *********" achievment in the Achievements UI before the Secret World gets unlocked.

Unfortunately the upgrade to Unity 6 resulted in some old solutions no longer solving correctly. Although we tested old solutions as part of the engine upgrade, we didn't catch some cases that our users have reported.

It's more important for us to keep previous solutions working for our players than to upgrade the underlying engine (which was a nice-to-have, not a necessity). So we have rolled back to the older version of Unity, while still keeping the other improvements and fixes from 1.5.16.
Sorry for any inconvenience, and thank you to our players for reporting this problem!

We've just released an update for Poly Bridge 3. While most of it is under the hood, it's a big one: the game now runs on Unity 6, the latest version of the engine. This keeps PB3 on a modern, supported foundation and brings updated rendering internals along with it. You shouldn't notice anything different, just the same game on a healthier engine. This touches nearly every part of the game, so if anything looks off after the update, please let us know!
When moving a node, highlight edges in red that constrain node movement
The gamepad cursor no longer shimmers along its edges while moving
Performance optimizations
Faster asset loading
Mute and Mute In Background now take effect immediately when toggled with a keyboard or gamepad (previously they only applied when clicked with the mouse or after closing the menu)
Canceling the on-screen keyboard in Steam Big Picture / on Steam Deck no longer confirms the dialog with empty text
Fix visual pop that occured when exiting to Main Menu with gamepad
Cancel in-progress joint placement when opening Pause Menu with gamepad
Fix dev (help) solutions for RB-01 (Preplanned) and VT-13 (Near Miss)

items.text: Poly Bridge 3 Small Update

Twitch Integration: The native Twitch integration feature has been retired. Due to low overall usage, the server infrastructure costs required to host and maintain this service are no longer sustainable.
We want to thank the community members and streamers who engaged with this feature during its run!
This small patch fixes an issue with the Weekly Challenges thumbnail not appearing when in the last 24 hours of the countdown.
We had some additional unexpected problems with the switch to automated looping Weekly Challenges. This update addresses all known issues... thank you for your patience!
Use the same Gallery as the original Weekly Challenge
Have their own unique save folder (not overlapping with the original Weekly Challenge)
The Seasons dropdown menu in the Weekly Challenges UI now sorts seasons with most recent at the top (this is a bit more user friendly, especially as the number of seasons gets larger over time).
There was a glitch in the matrix that was preventing Season 16 in the Weekly Challenges from starting. This has been fixed with this small update!

After 15 incredible seasons and 150 Weekly Challenges, we are introducing a new automated rotation. Moving forward, Poly Bridge 3 will cycle through these 150 classic challenges indefinitely, featuring a fresh leaderboard every time they return!
